name: Cable Pull-over
common_faults: bending the elbows excessively (turning it into a pulldown)
not achieving full lat stretch overhead
using too much weight and losing form

substitutions.note: compound bodyweight; full vertical pull pattern

contraindications: shoulder instability aggravated by overhead reaching under load
resistance_profile: constant cable tension; hardest with arms overhead at stretch; decreases as arms pull to hips

provenance.notes: Isolation exercise for lats with minimal bicep involvement. Cable provides constant tension unlike dumbbell pull-over. Good lat finisher after compound pulling. SFR heuristic.
